data.name: Naumaan
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Naumaan means 'giver of good news' or 'comforter'. It is a name of prophet Nuh (Noah) in the Quran, who was a helper and a source of comfort for his people during the great flood. The name is deeply rooted in the spiritual significance of providing solace and support during times of need.
